'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Matt Thomas DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thomas]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: I'm from SoCal, so I'm playing an Aaron Nelson deck. Transcription note: username on sheet reads "BreDerlin"/"Bren Derlin" (same player as p108); heavy shorthand; expanded only where the abbreviation has one meaning

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' Bren Derlin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
